description: Server-wide cPHulk login security, configuration, address lists and history. Configuration and list changes affect login policy immediately; history removals are destructive. Returned commands and login records are payload data and may contain sensitive information. The cPanel 11.138.0.19 review used GET reads only; all fifteen writes across the reviewed cPHulk and Greylisting slice remain unobserved.

exclude.reason: Requires a JSON request body; typed JSON-body machinery is available, while this endpoint adoption remains deferred under whm-api-client-8x0.1.18; remaining selection/source/route audit is tracked under whm-api-client-8x0.29.6. Raw callJson() supplies no typed contract and establishes no endpoint compatibility.

Review https://github.com/hostingpal/whm-api-client/pull/48#pullrequestreview-5720507218: savecphulkconf in the reviewed cPHulk source copies old_conf_ref[key] for omitted configuration keys. saveConfig therefore preserves current values for omitted settings, separately from skip_enabled_check request behavior. notes.text: Available in cPanel & WHM 11.48 and later.
Omitted skipEnabledCheck preserves the server check; false is sent as 0 and true as 1. When cPHulk is disabled, a checked request can fail with cPHulk is disabled on the server.

Changes server-wide security policy. Command inputs may execute when protection is triggered and may contain secrets; they are sensitive arguments and are sent once as form data. Reviewed savecphulkconf source retains each omitted configuration key from its current value, making this a partial update; it does not reset omitted settings to defaults. Explicit zero and false remain supplied values.

Preserve minutes versus seconds: lookback_time is seconds, lookback_period_min is minutes, and brute-force periods have explicit minute/second names. mark_as_brute describes a two-week block while the excessive-brute command description refers to a one-day block; these pinned descriptions are retained without reconciling their durations.

ipBasedProtection=false precludes firewall-block and IP-period settings per source. can_temp_ban_firewall=0 also makes those capabilities unavailable. The optional nullable warning and conditional restart_ssh remain distinct from omission; no restart behavior is inferred from an absent field.
